title: Themes — one design system, many looks

props.title: One system, many looks
props.subtitle: Open the theme panel (bottom-right) and switch between Corporate, Minimal, Playful and Startup. Every widget below reskins from the same OKLCH token layer — no per-widget theming.

props.title: Themed by variables
props.subtitle: Colors, radii, surfaces and typography all resolve from tokens.

items.title: Radii & spacing

items.title: Dark mode
items.description: Each theme ships coherent light and dark variants.

props.title: Three token layers
props.content: Primitive values feed semantic tokens, which themes override. Swap a theme and the whole page follows — the components never change.
